Primogen Council (A4-E01, Night 8, 10:30 p.m.). “The private elevator climbs forty-two floors without a sound. It opens onto an enormous room with a single wall of glass over Elliott Bay”: the car opens directly into the council room, through its east wall. The west wall is all glass (the bay, the cranes, the ferries, the Hound's island: off the map). “In the center there's a long table of dark wood with seven chairs”: the table runs east to west, with the head against the glass wall; Halloway stands at the head, his back to the bay, facing the elevator the Prince comes in by. Six chairs along the sides (Whitmore, Marchetti, Voight, Thornquist, Fry, and the Sheriff). In front of each chair, a closed folder with a name on it (tiles without text; the contents are AYU-08). Celeste (or her stand-in) and Mr. Pell stand behind Halloway, between the head of the table and the glass. The coterie stands. The room's furniture “looks like it has never been used.”

The vestibule. Behind the east double door wait the ghoul security (MEN-04, from the 40th floor) and Montgomery's dogs: “The dogs in the vestibule begin to howl.”

Halloway's office, in the northeast corner, with glass to the north and east. For negotiating with Halloway before the Council, in private.

Leaving (Escape). Either by the private elevator, which needs Halloway's key or Pell's (the car door is locked: the key opens it), or by the emergency stairs off the vestibule: forty-two floors (Stamina + Athletics Diff. 3 to avoid reaching the bottom at Hunger 5); the region at the foot of the flight marks the descent, with no map of the rest of the stairwell.

The private elevator runs from the street to the penthouse and from the penthouse to the vault on level −3, and it's the only access to the vault. In the car, the door half receives arrivals and the back half goes down to the vault (plan “torre-boveda”). The street stop has no map: the Storyteller moves the tokens by hand.

If Halloway flees (total exposure or defeat): “And he heads for the elevator,” goes down to level −3, takes the briefcase out of the vault, and hands it to Pell. If he wins, at 12:30 a.m. Pell leaves with the briefcase by the same elevator.

Combat: attacking Halloway here, in front of the Primogen, hands him the vote. Halloway doesn't fight: Daunt, and into the elevator.

The movable furniture (21) are unlocked tiles: they can be moved, knocked over or used as a barricade.

Placed tokens. Hidden ones are revealed from the token layer; the ones that depend on how the night went say when.
